scope: Primary learning references for 36 original advanced practice questions
data_origin: All question scenarios, figures, prices and policy statements are original synthetic examples. External sources support technical principles rather than the event syllabus or synthetic data values.
source_field_note: AQ27 and AQ31 have empty source_urls and explicit synthetic_arithmetic_or_evidence source_type because their self-contained arithmetic and invented documents do not assert external facts. Local provenance records below document them without attaching unrelated web citations.

sources.title: Cross-validation evaluating estimator performance
sources.verification: Official page opened and held-out evaluation passages read
supports: Group-aware and time-aware validation
Test set leakage when selecting settings
sources.caveats: RAG answer-key leakage is an application of the evaluation principle, not a claim that this page describes this particular synthetic question.

sources.title: Probability calibration
sources.verification: Official definition and reliability-diagram passages read
supports: Well-calibrated predicted probabilities correspond to observed positive fractions in prediction groups

sources.title: Common pitfalls and recommended practices
sources.verification: Official resampling-before-split leakage section read
supports: Resampling the entire dataset before splitting causes leakage and changes evaluation distribution

sources.title: Tuning the decision threshold for class prediction
sources.verification: Official probability-versus-decision and threshold-tuning sections read
supports: Threshold changes class decisions while fixed probability scores retain score-based ROC and PR curves
Business costs inform threshold selection
sources.caveats: Thresholds, costs and capacity constraints in AQ26 are invented.

sources.title: Metrics and scoring quantifying the quality of predictions
sources.verification: Official page opened; regression and classification metric definitions checked
supports: MAE, MSE and RMSE definitions
Precision and recall denominators
sources.caveats: The top-k document metric convention is explicitly defined in AQ28; calculations use original data.

sources.title: Preprocessing data
sources.verification: Official standardization and train-only fit example read
supports: Feature scales can dominate objectives
Fit scaling on training data and apply the same transform to other data

sources.title: Clustering
sources.verification: Official K-means objective and cluster evaluation concepts checked
supports: K-means minimizes within-cluster squared distance
Cluster labels identify partitions rather than semantic fault classes

sources.title: PCA
sources.verification: Official centered-but-not-scaled definition and explained-variance selection read
supports: PCA is linear dimensionality reduction
scikit-learn PCA centers but does not scale each feature
Variance explained differs from downstream label accuracy

sources.title: Optimizing Model Parameters
sources.verification: Official training and test loops read, including eval and no_grad comments
supports: Loss backward computes gradients and optimizer step updates parameters
eval and no_grad serve distinct roles in evaluation

sources.title: Zeroing out gradients in PyTorch
sources.verification: Official introduction explicitly describing accumulation into .grad read
supports: Repeated backward calls accumulate gradients unless they are reset
sources.caveats: The scalar loss and SGD numerical update are original independently checked arithmetic.

sources.title: Adam
sources.verification: Official Adam update formula and beta definitions read
supports: Adam maintains first and second gradient moment estimates and has a learning-rate parameter
sources.caveats: Versioned documentation is used for the definition, not as an installation requirement for this workspace.

sources.title: Conv2d
sources.verification: Official NCHW shape and output height/width formulas read
supports: Convolution output channels and floor-based spatial output formula
sources.caveats: Input tensor size and hyperparameters are original example values.

sources.title: Building effective agents
sources.verification: Official workflow/agent distinction and parallelization sections read
supports: Workflows use predefined paths while agents dynamically direct their processes
Independent subtasks can be parallelized
sources.caveats: The page notes tooling has changed since publication. Only stable architecture concepts are used; no claim about currently preferred vendor model or framework.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol tools specification
sources.verification: Official input/output schema, isError and security consideration sections read
supports: Input schemas and access control are separate requirements
Tool execution errors can use isError inside a result
Structured results require validation
sources.caveats: Uses a named published specification edition and does not assert this is the latest protocol revision. Cache-key and business-invariant designs are scenario applications.

sources.title: LoRA
sources.verification: Official low-rank update and frozen original weight passages read
supports: Low-rank update matrices can be trained while original weights remain frozen
sources.caveats: The stable URL redirected to main. Main documentation can change; no PEFT version installation is required.

sources.title: Quantization overview
sources.verification: Official overview description of lower-precision weight storage read
supports: Lower-precision weight storage reduces model memory requirements subject to method tradeoffs
sources.caveats: 7 billion weights and 4 bits are explicit hypothetical assumptions; not a measured model memory claim.

sources.title: How caching works
sources.verification: Official autoregressive key/value reuse explanation read
supports: KV cache reuses key/value representations of previously processed tokens
KV memory is distinct from weight storage

sources.title: Retrieval
sources.verification: Current official retrieval page opened after canonical path redirects; text-splitter and retrieval-context sections read
supports: Retrieved documents become runtime context
Text splitters break documents into retrievable context-sized chunks
sources.caveats: Preserving rules and exceptions is a proposed scenario remedy. AQ20 dates and policy applicability are defined entirely in the question, not by this documentation.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
sources.publisher: Patrick Lewis and collaborators via arXiv / NeurIPS 2020
sources.verification: Original paper abstract and publication record opened
supports: RAG combines parametric generation with retrieved nonparametric passages
sources.caveats: Scenario remedies for omitted exceptions, claim grounding and leaked answer keys are preparation applications, not claims of guarantees in the original paper.

sources.title: Semantic Search
sources.verification: Official asymmetric semantic-search and query/document encoding passages read
supports: Use compatible query and document encoding paths appropriate to the retrieval task
sources.caveats: The incompatibility of arbitrary independently trained spaces is the question's explicit assumption; different compatible asymmetric encoders can be valid.

sources.title: Padding and truncation
sources.verification: Official documentation opened after redirect from versioned default
supports: Token sequence length and model limits matter for input handling
sources.caveats: 8192 combined input/output tokens and overhead assumptions are invented for arithmetic and not a universal Transformers limit.

sources.title: SELECT
sources.verification: Official SELECT documentation opened
supports: Join row construction and aggregation semantics
sources.caveats: Lot data and event duplication counts are invented and their ratios are independently checked.

sources.title: datetime Basic date and time types
sources.verification: Official datetime documentation opened
supports: Aware datetimes and UTC offsets distinguish time zones
sources.caveats: Policy dates are invented; KST offset and conversion are explicitly stated and calculated in the question.

sources.title: Metric SI Prefixes
sources.verification: Official SI prefix page opened after older NIST URL redirect
supports: Decimal mega and giga scale factors
sources.caveats: 800 Mbps throughput and overhead-free transfer are hypothetical, and byte-to-bit conversion is defined in the question.

sources.title: LLM06 2025 Excessive Agency
sources.verification: Official excessive-permissions and least-privilege guidance opened
supports: Access controls and minimum necessary permissions should limit sensitive data use
sources.caveats: Cache partitioning is a proposed engineering application; this source does not define the synthetic cache implementation.

sources.title: json JSON encoder and decoder
sources.verification: Official JSON serialization and decoding documentation opened
supports: Parsing JSON is a format operation distinct from business calculations
sources.caveats: The yield invariant and numbers are supplied synthetic task conditions, not requirements defined by Python json.

sources.title: sqlite3 DB-API interface for SQLite databases
sources.verification: Official parameter-binding guidance opened
supports: Use placeholders for SQL values rather than string assembly
sources.caveats: Fixed identifier mapping is an application recommendation for the supplied two-table scenario.

sources.title: What are confidence intervals
sources.verification: Full official confidence interval section read
supports: Frequentist confidence levels describe repeated-interval coverage
One- and two-sided intervals are distinct

sources.title: Do two processes have the same mean
sources.verification: Official two-sample comparison section opened
supports: A difference estimate should be interpreted with uncertainty and the specified test alternative
sources.caveats: Accuracy difference interval is hypothetical and its validity is explicitly assumed, rather than derived using this page's process-time example.

sources.title: Original synthetic token-cost arithmetic
sources.verification: Input/output charges recomputed independently with Python decimal arithmetic
supports: Invented input price 2 USD per million tokens and output price 8 USD per million tokens yield 0.018 USD for the specified requests
sources.caveats: No external URL because no actual vendor price is asserted.

sources.title: Original synthetic goal-versus-experiment evidence
sources.verification: The two invented source statements are fully included in AQ31 and logically compared
supports: 30% planned target and 12% limited experiment are different claims and cannot be averaged as one demonstrated outcome
sources.caveats: No external URL because these statements are invented, not quotations of a real company's announcement.
